author: Wallet Up

sections.description:
Wallet Up (or Wal’UP) is your all-in-one payment solution for WordPress. Seamlessly integrate popular payment methods, generate beautiful QR codes, track analytics in real-time, and enhance your WooCommerce store with powerful payment options.

Core Features

  • Multi-Payment Integration: Accept payments via Cash App, Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, Meta Pay (formerly Facebook Pay), and WalupPay
  • Advanced QR Code Generator: Create and customize QR codes with logos, colors, styles, and more (Pro Only)
  • URL Shortener & Analytics: Generate shortened URLs with real-time click tracking and comprehensive analytics (Pro Only)
  • Real-Time Click Tracker: Monitor and analyze URL performance with instant notifications (Pro Only)
  • Donation System: Set up customizable donation pages with analytics and tracking (Pro Only)
  • WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly integrate with WooCommerce checkout
  • WPForms Integration: Add payment options to your forms (Pro Only)
  • Digital Business Card Generator: Create scannable business cards with payment information (Pro Only)

QR Code Features (Pro Only)

  • Logo Integration: Add your logo to the center of QR codes
  • Customizable Styles: Choose from rounded, circular, or classic QR code styles
  • Color Customization: Select custom colors for QR code foreground and background
  • Border Options: Customize borders and margins
  • Responsive Design: QR codes adapt to different device sizes
  • SVG Support: Generate high-quality vector QR codes
  • Preview Feature: Real-time preview while customizing

URL Shortener & Analytics (Pro Only)

  • Custom URL Shortening: Create branded short links
  • Click Tracking: Monitor clicks in real-time
  • Geographic Analytics: Track visitor locations
  • Referrer Tracking: See where traffic comes from
  • Custom Slugs: Create memorable URLs
  • Expiration Settings: Set links to expire after a specific time
  • Tags & Organization: Categorize and organize your links
  • Export Data: Download analytics as CSV

Donation System (Pro Only)

  • Customizable Donation Pages: Create beautiful donation pages
  • Multiple Payment Methods: Accept donations through various channels
  • QR Code Donations: Generate scannable donation QR codes
  • Donation Analytics: Track and analyze donation patterns
  • Custom Thank You Pages: Design personalized thank you experiences
  • Donation Management: Organize and track all donations

WooCommerce Integration

  • Checkout Integration: Add Wallet Up payment methods to WooCommerce checkout
  • Order Management: Track payments in WooCommerce orders
  • Custom Thank You Page: Display payment QR codes on order confirmation
  • Blocks Support: Compatible with WooCommerce Blocks checkout

Developer Features

  • Extensible Architecture: Well-documented hooks and filters
  • React Components: Modern UI built with React
  • API Endpoints: Integrate with external services
  • Shortcode System: Easily embed features anywhere
  • Theme Compatibility: Works with any WordPress theme
  • Mobile-First Design: Optimized for all devices

Privacy Policy

Wallet Up is committed to respecting user privacy:

  • The plugin does not collect personal user data beyond what is necessary for functionality
  • Analytics data is stored locally on your server
  • No data is sent to external services without explicit consent
  • The plugin automatically cleans up old data to minimize storage
  • All tracking features can be disabled

For questions about privacy, please contact privacy@walletup.app.

Disclaimers

Wallet Up does not imply endorsement by any of the payment services it integrates with. All logos, brand names, and trademarks are owned by their respective companies.

Cash App is a registered trademark of Block, Inc.
Venmo is a registered trademark of PayPal, Inc.
PayPal is a registered trademark of PayPal, Inc.
Zelle is a registered trademark of Early Warning Services, LLC.
Meta Pay is a registered trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

Support

For technical support, please visit:

  • Documentation: https://docs.walletup.app
  • Support Forums: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/wallet-up/
  • Email Support: help@walletup.app

Contribute

We welcome contributions to Wallet Up! Visit our GitHub repository to contribute code, report issues, or suggest features.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or greater
  • PHP version 8.1 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.7 or greater
  • SSL certificate for secure connections
  • GD or Imagick extension for advanced QR code features (optional)

Automatic Installation

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Wallet Up”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Go to Wallet Up in your admin menu to configure settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu

After Installation

  1. Configure your payment methods in the Wallet Up settings
  2. Set up your QR code display preferences
  3. Create your first shortened URL
  4. Add payment options to your site using shortcodes
sections.faq:
Which payment methods does Wallet Up support?

Wallet Up supports Cash App, Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, Meta Pay (formerly Facebook Pay), and WalupPay.

Do I need technical knowledge to use Wallet Up?

No, Wallet Up is designed to be user-friendly with an intuitive interface. Simply configure your settings and use shortcodes to add functionality to your site.

Can I customize the appearance of QR codes?

Yes! You can customize colors, size, style (rounded, circular, or classic), add your logo, adjust borders, and more.

How do I track payments made through QR codes?

Wallet Up includes comprehensive analytics for tracking QR code scans, link clicks, and payment interactions through the Analytics dashboard. However payments made are logged and hamdled directly through their respective platform provider.

Does Wallet Up work with WooCommerce?

Yes, Wallet Up integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce, allowing you to offer alternative payment methods at checkout.

Can I create donation pages with Wallet Up?

Yes, the donation system allows you to create customizable donation pages with multiple payment options and real-time tracking.

Is the URL shortener included in the free version?

No, the URL shortener and analytics is included in the Pro version. Advanced analytics and real-time tracking are available in the Pro version.

Does Wallet Up comply with GDPR requirements?

Yes, Wallet Up is designed with privacy in mind and complies with GDPR requirements. The plugin only collects necessary data for functionality and provides options for data management.

Can I use Wallet Up with WPForms?

Yes, Wallet Up integrates with WPForms to add payment options to your forms, making it easy to collect payments.

Do you offer support?

Yes, we offer support through our website and WordPress.org forums. Premium users receive priority support.
